title: End to end CLI tests with node:test and spawned processes
when: The user wants tests that run the real command line tool the way a user does, checking stdout, stderr and the exit code of each case.
prompt:
Goal: Tests that spawn the bin file with the current Node, feed input, and assert output and status in isolated temp folders.
Steps:
1. test/cli.test.mjs imports test from node:test, assert from node:assert/strict, spawnSync from node:child_process and fileURLToPath from node:url.
2. const BIN = fileURLToPath(new URL("../bin/tool.mjs", import.meta.url)); run(args, o = {}) returns spawnSync(process.execPath, [BIN, ...args], { encoding: "utf8", input: o.input ?? "", cwd: o.cwd, env: { ...process.env, NO_COLOR: "1", ...o.env }, timeout: 10000 }).
3. Cases: --help gives status 0 and Usage; an unknown flag gives 2, stderr text, empty stdout; valid input gives exact stdout; a missing file gives 1.
4. Stdin case: input "a\nb\n", assert the transformed lines.
5. Files: fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "tool-")), write fixtures, run with cwd there, assert created files, fs.rmSync in t.after.
6. Normalize endings before comparing: out.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").
7. Set XDG_CONFIG_HOME and HOME to the temp folder so the developer's own config never leaks in.
Quality bar:
- process.execPath, never whatever node is on PATH.
- The suite runs in seconds.
- Each exit code has a test.
Pitfalls:
- exec with a command string, breaking on spaces in paths.
- No timeout, so a tool waiting on stdin hangs the suite.
- Asserting on colored output.
Verify:
- [ ] Imports node:test and node:assert.
- [ ] Status, stdout and stderr asserted.
- [ ] Temp folders removed.
- [ ] node --test passes.
Output: test/cli.test.mjs and test/fixtures/.

examples.input: escrever testes que rodam minha CLI de verdade
examples.output: test/cli.test.mjs spawning process.execPath bin/tool.mjs with NO_COLOR, asserting status, stdout and stderr, temp folder fixtures
